Ingresso del piruvato nel ciclo di Krebs NEED-PDH-PYRUVATE-AXIS

Motivo del prossimo studio: verificare un'ipotesi Posizioni del bisogno: C3F3P1P3

In breve. Capire se la fosforilazione di PDH è più alta nelle cellule neurali prive di WWOX e se un inibitore di PDK la modifica in modo dipendente dal genotipo, aggiungendo un inibitore nanomolare pan-isoforma accanto al dicloroacetato (con riserve su selettività e disponibilità). In più (IT9 P6): un esperimento condizionale sull'asse HIF (proteina HIF-1alfa e HIF-2alfa nelle cellule neurali prive di WWOX, poi knockdown genetico e una leva di classe PX-478 contro un controllo di direzione), proposto e non eseguito. Restato (IT10 P2.1/P5): la direzione del cambiamento di HIF non è stabilita (condizionale); controllo genetico per primo; ossigeno fisiologico al 5% come condizione primaria; bracci per attività, MYC e stato di coltura.

Domanda. Is PDH phosphorylation higher in WWOX-deficient neural cells, and does a PDK inhibitor change it in a genotype-dependent way without lowering glucose in a hypoglycaemic model?

Dettagli: dati, effetto, fattibilità
Dati che potrebbero risolverla
The closing condition of card I01: PDHA1 Ser293 phosphorylation, total PDH, activity and a tracer experiment, genotype by inhibitor; a glycaemia arm in the constitutive knockout, where glucose at P10 is already about 95 against about 130. IT7 P6 2026-10-29: decisive measurement unchanged; read PDK1, LDHA, LDHB, HK2, SLC2A1 and BNIP3 transcripts beside it in the same cells, so the replicated WWOX-deficient human neural contrast that the P3 comparison named as missing is also a second transfer test; no computational ranking selects the compound arm. (IT7 P6: the network routes added no value and the signature route was not detected, not excluded.) IT8 P3 2026-10-29, restated IT9 P4a 2026-10-30: a nanomolar pan-isoform inhibitor is added alongside dichloroacetate for the genotype-by-inhibitor arm, because dichloroacetate inhibits the recombinant human kinase isoforms only at about 0.1 to above 5 millimolar in curated database rows and a null with it alone at cell-attainable concentrations would be uninterpretable, whereas in the one document that measured both on all four isoforms the inhibitor acts at about 20 to 170 nanomolar; caveats: pan-isoform (no isoform attribution), availability for research use not stated by the sources, neuronal engagement and brain exposure not shown, second-isoform assay on a different substrate. IT9 P6 2026-10-30 (card K01): the HIF axis upstream of PDK1 is a separate, conditional experiment that can share cells and lysates with this one: HIF-1alpha and HIF-2alpha protein in WWOX-deficient versus corrected human neural cells first (never measured; nuclear and cytoplasmic fractions, normoxia and hypoxia), then genetic HIF1A and EPAS1 knockdown and a PX-478-class lever, with a genetic-first arm C (VHL or EGLN1 loss; a prolyl-hydroxylase inhibitor only beside HIF-null and prolyl-hydroxylase-null controls, direction conditional (H-protect), not a 'mimic' of a disease direction) in knockout and corrected cells; deciding readout lactate or acidification and glucose uptake plus PGK1, ALDOA, ENO1, PFKP and PKM individually (the six readout genes and the 10-gene set are guard-scope members: a change there confirms the seed, it does not validate a lever), with network activity and viability giving the valence; the arms are conditional on the HIF-dependent shift being adaptive or harmful. IT10 P5 2026-10-31 (restated after IT10 P2.1): step 0 is run at 5 percent oxygen (physioxia) as the primary condition beside 21 and 1 percent, with a hypoxia marker and size matching in any organoid arm, an activity-silenced arm and a MYC loss-of-function arm for the rival explanations, a multielectrode network-activity readout, and two independent knockout clones with isogenic add-back.
Che cosa cambierebbe
A genotype-by-inhibitor interaction would give the first WWOX-system row for DCA on this need; the known glucose-lowering and neuropathy signals would remain as tags. A computational ranking of compounds does not change this: the IT7 P3 comparison found no added value for the network routes and an effect not detected, not excluded for the signature route, so the kind of study and the position of the need are unchanged. A null with dichloroacetate alone is not read as absence of a PDK effect. The HIF experiment (card K01) would change a different decision: a negative premise measurement drops the HIF axis for neural cells; knockdown that lowers lactate while viability or differentiation worsen marks the shift as adaptive and drops the lever; the opposite marks it harmful and gives the first WWOX-system row for the lever (F3 to F2 by rule); lactate falling with viability, network activity and differentiation unchanged or discordant leaves the valence unresolved. It does not change the position of the PDK arm of this need.
Fattibilità (solo ciò che è noto)
Precedente in fibroblasti umani a livello di abstract; le cellule WWOX-deficienti richiedono una richiesta di accesso solo in bozza, non inoltrata da qui.
Human fibroblast precedent exists at abstract level; the WWOX-deficient cells (organoids from a public deposit) need an access request that exists as a draft only and is not to be filed from here.

Motivo del prossimo studio: verificare un'ipotesi Posizioni del bisogno: F3P3

In breve. Capire se lattato o attività LDH sono aumentati nelle cellule neurali prive di WWOX; per lo stiripentolo non c'è sostegno a livello enzimatico da dati primari, e il test del nodo usa un inibitore nanomolare di LDHA umana la cui selettività su LDHB è da stabilire.

Domanda. Is LDH activity or lactate raised in WWOX-deficient neural cells? (IT8 P3 2026-10-29: the former second half of this question, whether stiripentol reaches an inhibitory level at all, is answered without enzyme-level support on primary data and is no longer asked of it.)

Dettagli: dati, effetto, fattibilità
Dati che potrebbero risolverla
Card E02 next measurement: lactate and LDH activity in WWOX-deficient human neural cells, the fly Ldh-alone arm and Wwox mRNA in the double line; the 42 to 500 micromolar LDH range is withdrawn as an exposure target for stiripentol (IT8 P3, below). IT7 P6 2026-10-29: read LDHA and LDHB activity separately (LDHB was the discordant gene in the P47T transfer test); no computational ranking selects the compound arm. (IT7 P6: the network routes added no value and the signature route was not detected, not excluded.) IT8 P3 2026-10-29, restated IT9 P4a 2026-10-30: the compound arm is a nanomolar human-LDHA inhibitor chosen from the curated target entries (205 qualify; 116 have no LDHB datum, 89 have a same-document LDHA and LDHB pair, of which only 2 are 30 fold or more on every pair, so selectivity over LDHB is to be established per compound); stiripentol stays only as a complex I and GABA-A comparator. Datum: enzyme data giving 7 percent inhibition at 2 millimolar and about 10 percent at 0.5 millimolar, no fitted LDH potency among its 88 curated rows (all read; one 2022 cell-level mouse-hepatocyte oxalate-output signal weighed, not decisive), a US label that names no LDH mechanism; stiripentol is not sufficiently supported as an LDH-engagement probe; the 42 to 500 micromolar figure is a secondary range.
Che cosa cambierebbe
If lactate is not raised, the need loses its WWOX observation and E02 moves to P3 by rule; if raised, the node is tested with a nanomolar human-LDHA inhibitor, not with stiripentol (IT8 P3), and a stiripentol effect would be read as complex I or GABA-A pharmacology. A computational ranking of compounds does not change this: the IT7 P3 comparison found no added value for the network routes and an effect not detected, not excluded for the signature route, so the kind of study and the position of the need are unchanged.
Fattibilità (solo ciò che è noto)
Linee cellulari e stock di mosca: non nota; nessuna richiesta o contatto eseguiti da qui.

Dettagli: dati, effetto, fattibilità
Dati che potrebbero risolverla
Card F04, step E1: the isolated NMDAR current under voltage control (AMPAR and GABA-A blocked) in knockout, heterozygote and wild-type slices: amplitude, decay, NMDA:AMPA ratio, GluN2B and GluN2A shares, resting potential and input resistance; then concentration-response of d-APV and of a GluN2B-selective tool, and a use-dependent pore blocker (memantine as a translation probe, with Mg2+ and holding potential stated). Che cosa cambierebbe
E1 decides whether an NMDAR gain is present or the dependence is permissive; a partial blocker is read only after E1, and without E1 a memantine result cannot be attributed to pyramidal receptors. A titration that cannot lower bursts inside a reachable range closes the magnesium strand.

Aumento di MYC e spostamento dello stato dei progenitori nella glia radiale priva di WWOX NEED-MYC-PROGENITOR-PROLIFERATION

Motivo del prossimo studio: chiarire una controevidenza Posizioni del bisogno: C2F3

In breve. Capire se l'aumento di MYC nella glia radiale e' una causa, un marcatore dello stato progenitore o una conseguenza del ciclo cellulare, e se il deficit dei marcatori di strato corretto dal gene nei neuroni indica un compartimento raggiungibile dopo la nascita.

Domanda. Is the MYC rise in WWOX-deficient radial glia a driver, a marker of retained progenitor state or a consequence of the cell-cycle shift, and does the layer-marker deficit that neuron-stage add-back restores define a compartment a postnatal lever could reach?

Dettagli: dati, effetto, fattibilità
Dati che potrebbero risolverla
Step 0 (computational, on the deposited single-cell data if access is granted): MYC and POU5F1 difference between knockout and wild-type radial glia within G1/G0 only and within matched potency strata. Step 1 (wet lab, two independent knockout clones and corrected lines): genetic MYC lowering against a cytostatic control, with SOX2+MYC+, pH3+ and NEUN+ fractions and absolute cell counts per organoid, wild-type-plus-compound groups included; A51 and a PIN1 probe as comparison arms only; add-back before week 4 and at week 10 with MYC and CTIP2/SATB2 readouts; the SCAR12 line stratified the same way.
Che cosa cambierebbe
If MYC difference vanishes within cell-cycle and potency strata, MYC is a marker and the need moves to inert for lever purposes. If genetic MYC lowering moves neuronal fractions in knockout beyond corrected cells and cell counts hold, the driver reading advances to a second model and the development question (a prenatal window) becomes the limit. If progenitor-stage add-back lowers MYC while neuron-stage add-back restores layer markers alone, the two compartments are separated and only the neuron compartment is a postnatal target.
Fattibilità (solo ciò che è noto)
Laboratorio con linee isogeniche di organoidi e una leva MYC inducibile; linee non disponibili (non nota); dati single-cell depositati con possibile richiesta di accesso.
Wet lab with isogenic human organoid lines and an inducible MYC lever; the lines are not held (not known); the deposited single-cell data may need an access request.

Stato redox e tono di NRF2 (ROS, citochine Il6/Il1b) NEED-REDOX-NRF2

Motivo del prossimo studio: verificare un'ipotesi Posizioni del bisogno: F3

In breve. Capire se nelle cellule neurali carenti di WWOX ci sono ROS, tono di NRF2 o citochine (proteina) alterati, e se attivare NRF2 cambia vitalità o attività di rete in modo dipendente da NRF2.

Domanda. In WWOX-deficient versus isogenic corrected human neural cells that include microglia or CNS-macrophage-like cells, are NRF2 target activity, ROS and IL-6/IL-1beta protein different, and does NFE2L2-dependent activation (KEAP1 knockdown, omaveloxolone, dimethyl fumarate, with monomethyl fumarate as a separate comparator, each against NFE2L2 loss) change viability, lipid peroxidation, network activity or cytokine protein more in knockout than in corrected cells?

Dettagli: dati, effetto, fattibilità
Dati che potrebbero risolverla
Step 0: nuclear NRF2 and KEAP1 protein, NQO1 activity, NQO1/HMOX1/GCLM/SRXN1 transcripts, ROS reporter at baseline and after an oxidative challenge, IL-6 and IL-1beta protein after LPS with or without ATP. Step 1: the activation arms above and NFE2L2 knockdown, both genotypes, with MEA network activity and SOX2/NEUN fractions. Guards: GFAP/IBA1 counts are held-out endpoints; the six IT7 readout genes cannot decide. IT11 P2.3 additions: dimethyl and monomethyl fumarate as separate arms; NFE2L2 loss as the dependence control for every compound; off-NRF2 readouts for the fumarates (NF-kB p65 translocation, HCAR2 dependence, GAPDH activity); omaveloxolone over a concentration series spanning the low-nM NRF2-linked window and the hundreds-of-nM NF-kB/JNK/growth window with NQO1 read at each point and free exposure reported; TNF as a discriminator (NRF2-only action predicts no TNF change); an astrocyte-containing challenged arm; clone and batch recorded.
Che cosa cambierebbe
If neither ROS nor NRF2 tone nor cytokine protein differs and activation changes nothing: the axis moves to inert and the card is closed. If ROS is raised and activation corrects it in knockout cells more than in corrected cells (NFE2L2-dependent): arm R advances to a second model; omaveloxolone paediatric limits then become the development question.
Fattibilità (solo ciò che è noto)
Laboratorio con linee neurali isogeniche e una fonte di microglia; disponibilità non nota.
Wet-lab with isogenic human neural cells and a microglia source; two commercial research compounds (availability UNVERIFIED); step 0 is a one-to-two-week assay set; whether a laboratory with the isogenic lines will run it: not known. Unknown share: 28,234 of 44,211 records (63.9%) have no access evidence in any source queried. Unknown means not obtained, not "not available".

Categories overlap (a record can have OTC and prescription evidence), so the rows above do not sum to the total. Mutually exclusive signatures, which do sum to the total:

Scope. An access category is US evidence found in the sources on the retrieval dates shown under technical details (openFDA NDC listings, NIH DSLD labels matched by normalised name, ChEMBL and MATRIX status flags). It is not an approval, not appropriateness for any person, and not a safety statement. Non-US access was not obtained. Catalogue note: evidence of access in at least one US listing on a date, scoped per entry; not approval, appropriateness or safety, and not access for a given person or country. DSLD: the bulk probe was interrupted; names not probed have NO supplement evidence either way (unknown, not negative).

Not obtained: dietary-supplement status for any compound that was not probed in DSLD, and for all probed ones except by normalised-name match (DSLD labels carry no identifiers); non-US access (EMA, MHRA, PMDA, national lists): no open bulk source was found; US NDC products without a UNII (cannot be linked by identifier); DGIdb newer than the 2024-06-10 TSV release

Cells and distinct families are different units: one family can hold several cells (one per need). A count of cells is not a count of compounds.

none: no score, no ordering by evidence volume; filter by disposition, need or criterion. Order is need id then row id.. 596 priority pairs are flagged exploration (need direction uncertain).

Dispositions are distinct: source queried without result (the sources were asked and returned no row for the record), incomplete or failed query (a source was not in state OK; this is never a negative) and not relevant / no catalogue link found and insufficient data (a decision from the data that exist) are different statements and are not merged.

Piste derivate dal catalogo e loro disposizioni

Curated, reasoned endings of catalogue searches (iteration 3, closed-loop demonstration, scientist-b, 2026-10-28). Read by repurposing_join.py handoff. A disposition is a decision about a search, not a claim about biology and not a ranking. Coverage version used: main 315cd50c (before the ABAT / GtoPdb artefact correction of task/it3-search2).

A catalogue target listing (a stated action, or none) is a source statement, not a recommendation. Reasoned endings of searches, including abstentions and opposite mechanisms, each with what would reopen it. Same content as the section "Catalogue-derived leads" of the handoff (../../repurposing_batch_selection_20261028_module.md). Sources: coverage/lead_dispositions.json.

premature-stop read-through agents (ataluren, aminoglycosides, ELX-02) for WWOX nonsense alleles
Why
The need lists only WWOX as a target, so the catalogue returns no read-through agent through it; agents sit on the ribosome (ChEMBL: ataluren 80S ribosome modulator). Sequence enumeration of 32 ClinVar nonsense alleles: 23 predicted NMD-sensitive, 1 borderline, 8 predicted escape; all five census 'candidate' alleles are NMD-sensitive, and no allele has the UGA-C context. No WWOX read-through or NMD measurement exists. Closest nonsense-DEE trial (ataluren in CDKL5/Dravet, n=15) was negative.
Reopening condition
a measured PTC transcript level in patient-derived cells for a recorded WWOX nonsense allele, or any WWOX read-through experiment
Next experiment
transcript-level NMD assay (NMD-discriminating arm) on a patient-derived line carrying p.Arg264* or p.Arg54*, and on a predicted-escape allele such as p.Gln353*

LD-007decision: abstentionNEED-NEUROINFLAMMATION-GLIA
IL-1-axis and JAK-STAT agents as a class (IL-1 receptor antagonist via IL1R1; caspase-1 inhibitor via CASP1; IL-1beta antibodies; NLRP3 inhibitor; JAK2 inhibitors)
Why
The sign of the glial difference conflicts between species (null and P47T mouse excess; Wwox-mutant rat deficit from PND 5; human organoid no reactive programme), the time order of gliosis and seizures was never measured in the same animals, and every verified compound precedent is acute or post-infectious and uncontrolled or uninformative for long-term outcome, with acute seizure-control reports for anakinra and no usable trial-level VX-765 result (abstract level, NOT WWOX EVIDENCE). Catalogue links exist only as exploration rows (no stated direction for 439 of the 642 non-excluded intervention-target rows; 738 intervention-target rows before 96 exclusions).
Reopening condition
a time course of glial density against first spike in a Wwox-deficient model showing glia above wild type before the first spike, or any glial endpoint after a compound in a Wwox-deficient system
Next experiment
time course P5 to P17 with simultaneous recording and glial density in cortex and hippocampus (cycle README section 12); no compound arm

Limiti dichiarati

  • Association is not modulation, and modulation is not rescue. A headline link (L1) is a source statement about a target; it says nothing about a change in a WWOX-deficient system.
  • No efficacy is shown or implied. L3 is an assertion listed as pertinent to the need, with its sign and scope (other-disease precedent, enzyme or cell-free engagement and safety signals are separate states); L4 is a technical comparison against the disease change in a WWOX system, not efficacy and not safety.
  • Scores are not probabilities. There is no score or probability in this view. Dispositions are reasoned categories; the order is need id then row id, not evidence volume. Any model score elsewhere in the module is not a probability.
  • Combinations are not inferred. No synergy, complementarity or joint effect is computed; sets of compounds are not scored.
  • Exploration lists. For the 13 needs whose direction is uncertain, L2 is not evaluable and the compound list is for exploration, not a list of favourable treatments.
  • Access is US evidence, dated; not approval, appropriateness or safety. Unknown is not negative. Safety is NOT_ASSESSED for every family; potency is not carried.
  • A family is not a drug. Records are source-level substance records (salts, stereoisomers and source-only rows count once each); name twins are not merged.
  • Pertinence is listed by hand per assertion; an assertion not in the pertinence table is not counted. Absence in cards (none in cards) is not a negative finding. Seizure-need cells are symptom-level inferences. Role rows carry certainty qualifiers.
  • Public disease and reference-genotype level only. Nothing here is medical advice.

Source limits recorded by the module: catalogue links are source statements; no potency is carried; DGIdb is a STALE export (2024-06-10); current service coverage not ingested; ChEMBL non-human target rows are set aside, not matched; pertinence of an assertion to a need is judged in assertion_pertinence.tsv (a curated input, reviewable); unlisted assertions are not counted; L4 is a technical bridge comparison, not efficacy; case_level = uncontrolled clinical report; needs' own WWOX observations are not interventions and fill no compound cell; seizure-need cells are symptom-level inferences, not mechanism-linked to WWOX; GRIN and T-type couplings rest on one experiment each
